answer: Decaying identity dividends: each new identity must accrue a zephyr-thin balance of activity credits, released only after 30 days of continuous signed work. Clones earn nothing until then, while every registration consumes a cedar-sealed hardware attestation the operator must buy. Because dividends decay without use, farmed identities cost more in attestations and idle time than they ever collect, so each marginal clone is strictly negative-EV. An ember of reputation from any prior account does not transfer.
